title: Record that one F2 thin map misses the three-leaf paired star.
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Over F_2, at block size 2 and three paired leaves, no single thin map meets the paired-star endpoint. The census covers every legal orthogonal resolution, including nonzero off-diagonal blocks and noncommuting stage projectors, and every order of the six full calls. Two thin maps of ranks 4 and 4 still meet the endpoint.

This is a finite obstruction. It is not a construction, not a native caller, and not a kappa improvement. The chronological rank floor at this size is 6, so one map was not already forbidden by rank. The commuting-projector theorem needs two maps only when the projectors commute; that hypothesis is dropped here.

Remaining obligations: total thin rank 6 or 7 with two maps, entries outside F_2, three or more full calls in a stage, and the open g=13, q=8 and g=31, q=26 profiles. Selected kappa is unchanged.

## Task and overlap

Routine session r100, item 3 of the revision-8 eligible list after closed handoffs: new decoders and interfaces. The ordered list used is:

1. Complex helpers (p104-side-correction, coverage-law-change)
2. BIT (bit-helper-contract)
3. New decoders and interfaces
4. Supplier audit (supplier-boundary-audit)
5. All-size audit (uniform-transfer-audit)
6. Verification tooling (replay-runtime)
7. bit-new-register-model
8. r437-carrier-integration
9. complex-rank-shape-decoder
10. complex-new-helper-inventory

Card `joint-query-controller`, scope refined. Base commit `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a` (upstream CrocSwap main). Package `research/paired-star-one-thin-gap`.

The card's first experiment says to read #5617, #5631, #5649, and #5747 before rebuilding an excluded schedule. #5747 already excludes the 31-leaf five-rank-two target and shows that commuting projectors need at least `ceil(g/2)` thin maps. The five-map profiles g=13, q=8 and g=31, q=26 stay open and need noncommuting projectors. This package tests the smallest paired case of that escape: g=3, d=2, one thin map, over F_2.

Overlap checked against open upstream PR titles and two nearby bodies (#6857 no-idle query roots, #6717 the 7q stage-rank budget), Discussion #1166 through 2026-11-07T22:19Z, and Discussion #5593 through 2026-11-03. Those do not contain this census. #5747 is the merged predecessor. No fork branch under `cursor/*paired*`, `*thin*`, `*coupled*`, or `*star*` matched this question. GitHub search is not a full-text proof that no open PR body mentions the same finite statement.

## Validation

Python 3.12, numpy 1.26.4.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/paired-star-one-thin-gap
```

Registered replay passed: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_PAIRED_STAR_ONE_THIN_GAP` under both `python3 -B` and `python3 -O -B`. Counts: 12 resolutions, 96 noncommuting ordered pairs, 1,244,160 orders, 159,984 pure hits, 0 candidates sent to the polynomial replay. The two-map control matches the endpoint in the polynomial ring; deleting one thin map misses it; the gap formula recovers the second control map. One noncommuting order locks the field formula against the polynomial word at all seven gaps.

Not run: a proof assistant, a larger-field census, a two-map rank-6 search, and any native or supplier replay. `scripts/research_selected_baseline.py` was not rerun; the selected record is provenance only.

## Credit

The paired-star contract, the rank floor, and the commuting map-count are from PR #5747 (Ali Romman), with the predecessor statements in PR #5673, PR #5631, and PR #5617. The two-map control is the construction in `research/coupled31-chronology/COMMUTING.md` at g=3, q=1.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. Independent human review and a proof-assistant proof are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

- Can two thin maps meet total rank 6 or 7 on this same contract? The floor is 6 and the control has total rank 8.
- Does one thin map appear over a larger characteristic-two field, or with three or more full calls in a stage?
- Do the g=13, q=8 and g=31, q=26 five-map profiles exist when projectors need not commute? This census does not lift.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The package metadata check is fast and caught the pin format before the two-minute census. Replaying both the normal and `-O` commands doubles that census; one command would have been enough, because the checks raise rather than assert.
